# Collections

Where Eleventy collections get registered.

## What's here

- `index.js`: runs the setup in order, Sanity first, then navigation
- `sanity.js`: hands off to the Sanity data layer
- `navigation.js`: registers navigation collections

## How it connects

- Uses [data/sanity](../../data/sanity/README.md) and the [navigation builder](../services/NavigationBuilder.md).
- Loaded from `eleventy.config.js`.

## See also

- [Eleventy setup](../README.md)
